ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute concerns trip TRP-02813 (Jurong Point to Blk 610 Clementi West St 1) and is decided on the artifacts in the bundle.

1. The fare was an upfront quote. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02813, weight 1.0) shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 21.50 and total_charged 28.30, payment status CHARGED. On an upfront-quoted trip POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, so the rider cannot recover a distance or time refund however long the route turned out to be. The rider's remedy is the amount by which the charge exceeds the quote plus any properly chargeable pass-through or statutory line: 28.30 less 21.50 less 0.00 = SGD 6.80, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 6.80. The rider contested SGD 7.50; SGD 6.80 of that is recoverable and the balance of SGD 0.70 is not, because nothing on an upfront-quoted trip makes the excess above the overcharge refundable.

2. The route was longer than booked. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02813, weight 1.0, 98 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s) measures 12.42 km against the booked optimal distance of 9.2 km stored on the trip record at booking. The excess is 3.22 km, or 35.00%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km absolve). The trace figure of 12.42 km governs over the rounded trip-record copy of 12.4 km, as POL-RD-01 itself requires. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), so no independent corroboration is needed to establish the deviation.

3. The deviation is established but not material. 35.00% is below the 50% materiality test and 3.22 km is below the 8.0 km test, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not triggered and no driver-conduct referral is made. In any event the driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 across 260 completed trips over 90 days, so no repeat pattern is established; the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

4. The driver's explanation does not change the result. The counterparty statement 'The meter adds the extra distance' cites no evidence ID and invokes no clause; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that points to no artifact carries no weight, and it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02813-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and under POL-RD-13 any external-cause excuse carries no weight.

5. Nothing else exonerates or adds to the money. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02813, weight 1.0) has 0 messages, so there is no rider-requested detour (POL-RD-04) and no distance is excluded. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded (POL-RD-05). The vehicle is RYDE_X, not a pooled product (POL-RD-12). The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry, no airport surcharge (the trip neither starts nor ends at an airport) and no waiting fee, so there is no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09. The rider's profile does not require extra corroboration (deviation_claims_60d is 0).

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.80 to the rider. No driver compensation is payable: the fare is upfront, no unbilled-distance shortfall is recorded, and no rider-requested detour was compensated. The monetary effect of SGD 6.80 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes automatically. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: you were quoted SGD 21.50 and charged SGD 28.30, and you are right that the route was longer than quoted. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02813 records 12.42 km against a booked optimal of 9.2 km on trip record EV-TRIP-02813 - an excess of 3.22 km, or 35.00% - which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace is also clean for policy purposes: 98 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and stands on its own. However, this trip was sold on an upfront quote. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-02813 records fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with a quoted fare of SGD 21.50 and a charged total of SGD 28.30, so the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, the detour did not cost you more on those lines, and POL-RD-02 does NOT run. Your remedy is POL-RD-11(a): the amount by which the charged total exceeds the quote plus the properly chargeable pass-through lines. The pass-throughs are nil (no ERP gantries, SGD 0.00 airport surcharge, SGD 0.00 waiting-time fee), so the refund is SGD 28.30 - SGD 21.50 - SGD 0.00 = SGD 6.80, rounded up to SGD 6.80. You contested SGD 7.50; SGD 6.80 is returned and the remaining SGD 0.70 is not recoverable, so this is a PARTIAL_REFUND. To the driver: your statement that 'the meter adds the extra distance' is not an explanation the policy accepts. It cites no evidence ID and invokes no clause, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion without an artifact carries no weight; under POL-RD-13 an uncited external-cause excuse carries no weight where no advisory is on file. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02813-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no party cited it as the basis of an exculpatory clause, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and this is a gap in the bundle, not an escalation. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure. No rider-requested detour applies: the chat log EV-CHAT-02813 holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint for POL-RD-04, and no distance is excluded. No relocation applies: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, original_pickup, original_dropoff and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the booked optimal of 9.2 km stands. This is not a pooled trip: vehicle_type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12 is not in issue. The deviation is established but NOT material - 35.00% is below the 50% materiality threshold and 3.22 km is below the 8.0 km absolute figure - so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral issues; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over completed_trips_90d of 260, so no pattern exists, and the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) must not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure under POL-GEN-01. There are no ERP charges, tolls or surcharges to correct, so no POL-RD-09 pass-through refund and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises. No driver compensation is due: on an upfront quote your distance and time revenue was fixed at booking, and the excess was not rider-requested. Confidence is 0.90: the decision rests on the fare breakdown EV-FARE-02813 (weight 1.0) and the trace EV-GPS-02813 (weight 1.0); the missing advisory carries no fact and does not cap it. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties are told the same thing, and the arithmetic is the same either way.

The route deviation is real. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02813) measures 12.42 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff, against a booked optimal of 9.2 km on the trip record — an excess of 3.22 km, or 35.00%. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (above 20% and above 0.8 km). The trace is clean for policy purposes: 98 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and max gap 0 s, so POL-RD-07 does not impair it and no independent corroboration is required. The deviation is established but not material — 35.00% is below the 50% materiality figure and 3.22 km is below the 8.0 km absolute figure — so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is not triggered by materiality, and in any event the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0, below both the 3-or-more and the 0.05-ratio limbs, so no repeat-pattern referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and grounds nothing.

The money, however, is not a distance refund. This is an UPFRONT_QUOTE trip (quoted fare SGD 21.50, charged total SGD 28.30), so under POL-RD-11 POL-RD-02 does not run and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess; the detour cost falls on the driver. The rider's remedy is confined to POL-RD-11(a): the amount by which the charge exceeds the quote, less the pass-through and statutory lines properly chargeable under POL-RD-09. Those lines are nil here — no ERP gantries, no tolls, airport surcharge SGD 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, waiting-time fee SGD 0.00. The refund is therefore 28.30 − 21.50 − 0.00 = SGD 6.80, which is already at a 0.05 increment. The rider's framing of the SGD 6.80 as a distance refund reaches the right figure by the wrong route; the amount is granted, but the contested SGD 7.50 exceeds it and the remaining SGD 0.70 is not recoverable on these facts.

The driver's statement that 'the meter adds the extra distance' is given no weight. It names no artifact and no clause, and on an upfront-quoted trip the meter does not increase the price the rider was quoted; under POL-RD-08 an assertion citing no evidence discharges no burden. The bundle's only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02813-01) is MISSING at weight 0.0, but no party cited it as the artifact its excuse rests on, so under POL-RD-13(1) this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and the case is decided on the trace and the ledger as they stand. No POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises because there is no unmatched gantry line and no misplaced surcharge. No POL-RD-06(c) referral arises because no pattern is established.

The deciding figures come from EV-FARE-02813 (charged total 28.30, quoted fare 21.50, properly chargeable 0.00) at weight 1.0 and the deviation from EV-GPS-02813 / EV-TRIP-02813 at weight 1.0, so the ruling is not capped below the platform floor. The refund of SGD 6.80 is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold and executes on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
